newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine garment exports dip 1.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippine garment exports dip 1.3 percent.

text.p: Philippine garment exports as of mid-December dipped by 1.3 percent to $2.691 billion compared with $2.727 billion in the same period in 1995, a report from the Garment and Textile Exports Board (GTEB) said on Monday.

Government officials earlier said the country's garment exports had been outpriced by cheaper products from other countries. Garments comprise the second-biggest segment of the Philippines' overseas sales.

Of the total garments exported, sales to quota countries fell by 5.3 percent to $2.036 billion versus last year's $2.151 billion, while those to non-quota countries rose by 13.7 percent to $655 million from $576 million, the report said.
Among the quota countries, the U.S. was the largest market for the Philippines' garments, but sales were 6.2 percent lower at $1.592 billion from $1.697 billion a year earlier.
